model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions (k) and coverage for different models, including Llama-3B, Llama-3B + FT, Llama-1B, and Llama-1B + FT. The x-axis represents the number of completions (k) on a logarithmic scale, ranging from 2^0 to 2^8, with tick labels at powers of 2. The y-axis represents coverage on a linear scale, ranging from 0.4 to 0.9, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The four lines in the plot are: Llama-3B (blue circles, solid line), which starts at approximately 0.44 coverage at k=2^0 and increases to around 0.93 at k=2^8; Llama-3B + FT (green triangles, dashed line), starting at about 0.49 coverage at k=2^0 and reaching 0.94 at k=2^8; Llama-1B (light blue circles, solid line), beginning at roughly 0.4 coverage at k=2^0 and rising to approximately 0.85 at k=2^8; and Llama-1B + FT (light green triangles, dashed line), which starts at around 0.42 coverage at k=2^0 and increases to about 0.91 at k=2^8. All lines exhibit an upward trend as the number of completions (k) increases.
